title: MD-enhanced DFT investigation of β-cyclodextrin as drug delivery system for Ampyra drug
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32626-32637
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04351D, Paper

Al-shimaa S. M. Rady, Peter A. Sidhom, Lamiaa A. Mohamed, Khalid Elfaki Ibrahim, Shahzeb Khan, Mahmoud A. A. Ibrahim
The effectiveness of β-cyclodextrin (β-CD) as a drug delivery system for the Ampyra (AMP) drug was studied using the molecular dynamics (MD) simulation technique and density functional theory (DFT) calculations.
